terms.metaDescription: The rules for using Amerivo English as a student or a teacher: bookings, payments, safety, and the ban on sharing contact details.
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.englishNotice: The Terms of Service are written in English, which is the legally binding version. If you need help understanding them, contact us.
terms.keyPoints: In short: never share your e-mail, phone number, links or social media with another user, and keep all lessons and payments on Amerivo. Messages, classroom chat, notes and documents are checked for your safety. Breaking these rules can lead to account suspension and to the fees described in Section 8.
